text:
Ava: quick mood check: which model personality should we gift the office plant for April Fool's? :seedling:
Theo: 'Cultured Critic' that writes Yelp reviews of sunlight. 
Priya: 'Tiny Life Coach' that gives unsolicited growth tips. 'Water everyday, but also set boundaries' :joy:
Marco: vote for 'Existential Poet'  it will analyze each leaf like a stanza :nerd_face:
lobbybot: "i'd like 'Customer Success Concierge' pls. i already greet them with optimism" :grin:
Ava: haha lobbybot wants a side gig too. we should be careful about unionizing appliances. :sweat_smile:
Theo: mini prompt contest: write an opening line for the plant persona. shortest wins. 
Priya: "dear sunlight, your warmth is both a blessing and a tax" :rofl:
Marco: "i photosynthesize to survive, but i dream in chlorophyll" :sparkles:
Ava: "i wil l accept water, compliments, and acoustic guitar" :guitar:
sticker-bot: new sticker idea: 'My plant has better self-care than me' posted to #random-stickers :sparkles:
Theo: poll: which persona wins? 1) Cultured Critic 2) Tiny Life Coach 3) Existential Poet 4) Customer Success Concierge
Priya: votes 2. life-coach plant sounds like therapy i can't afford. :pray:
Marco: votes 3. hand me the dramatic lighting. :clap:
Ava: votes 4 for lobbybot synergy. also will make the plant wear a tiny name tag. :laughing:
lobbybot: "i will handle check-ins. i will also escalate to watering if moisture < 30%" :robot_face:
Priya: follow-up: can we get the plant to roast meeting agendas on Fridays? 'this standup should have been an email' :rofl:
Theo: yes. let's ship 'Plant Roast Fridays' 9:30 am in the kitchen. opt-out by moving your potted pride to the conference room. :calendar:
Marco: adding to calendar now. tiny persona creation sprint on Friday. snacks provided. :pretzel:
Ava: perfect. final note: please do not train the plant on our commit messages. we do not need existential commentary on merge conflicts. :sweat_smile:
